values.options-considered:
- One shared queue with priorities
- A queue per merchant
- A separate retry queue with limits per merchant
values.decision: A separate retry queue with limits per merchant. A queue per merchant was the fairest, but it meant thousands of queues to run.

values.why: We copied the tax rules into the checkout service to meet the launch date. Every rule change now has to be made in two places, and they have drifted once already.
